# Vendored Unraid plugin manager (test-only)

`plugin` is Lime Technology's plugin manager script, copied unmodified from
`unraid/webgui` (`emhttp/plugins/dynamix.plugin.manager/scripts/plugin`, commit
26eb1b5c1d547ddbf44a38e63956ba24f659098b, 2026-10-06). It is GPLv2-only, Copyright
2005-2025 Lime Technology, and is used here solely to run the plugin package through
the real installer inside a throwaway container. It is never shipped in the plugin.
